title: Navy, Coast Guard plan Rs 15,000 crore deal for 76 helicopters to replace ageing fleet

This venture emphasizes indigenous manufacturing, supported by collaborations with international firms, ultimately boosting the operational efficiency of both maritime forces.

title: Michigan court upholds 35-year driveway easement after family access dispute

The affected family sought relief through various legal channels. The court ultimately endorsed a permanent easement while rejecting opposing claims. After the plaintiff’s passing, his son continued the pursuit, leading to a final ruling. The appeals court found no grounds to reverse the default judgment against the opposition.

title: Shiva's tear birthed Katas Raj, where love and loss live on
content: Katas Raj Pond, located in Pakistan's Punjab province, is associated with the mythology of Lord Shiva. This sacred site is believed to have formed from a tear shed by Shiva after his wife Sati's death. The surrounding temple complex includes ancient structures dating back to the early medieval period. Legends connect Katas Raj to the Mahabharata and the Pandava brothers' exile.

title: As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees

A recent study monitoring 346 snakes indicates that juvenile pythons exhibit a tendency to climb trees more than their adult counterparts. This knowledge assists wildlife officials in pinpointing these snakes within thick vegetation.
